items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: Well, somebody in that band I was going to ask you about. ... Oh, John Henry Braggs.

ctx.x: Well, somebody in that band I was going to ask you about. Well, you only had John Alfred, the drummer. Oh, the guitar player.

Oh, John Henry Braggs. He's still living. He's in San Antonio. He doesn't play anymore. Did he sing the blues ever? No. Just played the banjo. He played an old-style banjo, what they call the plectrum banjo, five strings. Mm-hmm. Good musician. His wife was a blues singer, Ed L. Braggs.
I believe he may have recorded some himself, you know, later on. Maybe. I'll have to look it up.
